dishes.name: Potthucke
dishes.desc: Grated potato bake with onions and bacon, baked in a pot or tin, sometimes with sausage. A traditional Sauerland and Siegerland dish.

dishes.name: Sauerländer Krüstchen
dishes.desc: Breaded pork cutlet on bread with a fried egg, a hearty Sauerland pub dish.

dishes.name: Siegerland Struwen
dishes.desc: Small potato dumplings tossed in a pan with bacon and onions, a Siegerland farmhouse dish.

dishes.name: Riewekooche
dishes.desc: Dense grated-potato cake baked in the oven, a Siegerland variant of the potato pancake eaten with applesauce or bread.
